fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-12-15 at about 22:15, it was reported that items including a tablet and a set of keys were taken from an unattended premises at Senthil Garden Main Street. Saranya Murugan approached Salem West PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000193. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Mohan Ramasamy, using the number 9000000458. Arun Babu (9000000379) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. Potentially relevant material referenced includes a call detail reference and a witness statement. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00277, as the mobile number 9000000458 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly entered through an unsecured entry point.
fields.Keywords: property theft, valuables, witness, main street, suspect, mobile number, night, witness statement
